uri.description: AT-URI of the post to update

content.description: Updated content - main text for text posts, description for media, etc.

facets.description: Updated annotations for rich text (mentions, links, formatting, block structure)

embed.description: Updated embedded content (note: changing embed type may be restricted)

editNote.description: DEPRECATED, retained for backward compatibility: an optional note explaining the edit. This field ships on main; removing it is a non-additive break, so it stays declared as an optional input until a new-NSID change retires it.

cid.description: New CID of the updated post

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: User is not authorized to edit this post

errors.name: ConcurrentModification
errors.description: The post changed between being read and being written, so the edit was composed against content that no longer stands. Re-read the post and re-apply the edit; the server does not merge, because re-applying server-side would silently erase a change the editor never saw.

errors.name: NoAuthorCredentials
errors.description: The service holds no credentials it can write to the author's repository with. Distinct from an expired caller session: signing in again is the fix for a person and no fix at all for a non-interactive author whose stored grant was revoked.

errors.name: EditWindowExpired
errors.description: DEPRECATED, retained for backward compatibility: no edit window is enforced - a post is editable by its author for as long as it exists. This name ships on main; removing a declared error is a non-additive break, so it stays declared until a new-NSID change retires it.

errors.name: InvalidUpdate
errors.description: DEPRECATED, retained for backward compatibility: never emitted. Refusals this once covered are answered by name instead - an edit naming a different community is an InvalidRequest validation error, and a post whose collection is not editable is the same. This name ships on main; removing a declared error is a non-additive break, so it stays declared until a new-NSID change retires it.
